source.title: Dickinson College Commentaries — Latin Core Vocabulary
source.attribution: Dickinson College Commentaries, Christopher Francese and the Dickinson College core-vocabulary team (2012–13; current online list).
source.rankBasis: DCC frequency rankings derived from the LASLA Dictionnaire fréquentiel et index inverse de la langue latine (1981). Lower numbers indicate more common words within the list.
source.scope: The current DCC core-list export contains 997 entries. Unlisted words have no measured rank in this dataset; omission is not a precise rarity estimate.
source.sourceAnomalies: Preserved exactly: rank 12 is absent; quisquam and vero both have rank 280; maximum published rank is 997.
source.adaptation: Converted CSV to JSON, added stable IDs and macronless lowercase lemma keys, and added aliases explicitly present in DCC headwords. Definitions and published ranks are unchanged. This adapted dataset is distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0.
